_comment: This is the club's board roster. To update it, edit the list below. Each board member needs a name and a role. Keep the square brackets and commas as they are — add or remove whole { ... } blocks. The website's About page reads this file automatically. NOTE: per the board's privacy decision, we list Name and Role only here (no personal emails) since this file is public. A single club contact email lives in site.json instead.
